concept.title: Find your way around
concept.shortdesc: The same pages on a phone and on a PC: a bottom tab bar on the phone, a grouped sidebar on the PC.

section.title: The pages

strow.stentry: Inbox, Today, Approvals, Chat, Notifications, Drive
Accounts, Devices, Storage, Settings, Notification settings

section.p: On a phone, Inbox, Today, Approvals and Chat are in the tab bar; everything else is under More, which also has the theme switch and Install app. A dot on More means a page inside it has something new.

section.title: The top bar

dlentry.dd: Opens Notifications; the badge is the unread count.
Help for the page you are on. See Help in the app.
Green while the app has a live connection to the server; pages update by themselves. Reconnecting… means it lost the connection and is getting it back, for example during a deploy.
System, Light or Dark. On a phone the button cycles through them.

section.p: Badges on Approvals and Notifications show what is waiting, and the installed app's icon shows the unread count where the phone supports it. The sidebar's foot shows what the agents have spent today.

conbody.p: Choose ? in the top bar, or press F1, to open the help for what you are doing.

ul.li: It opens on the help for the page, or more precisely for the field that has focus, the button you last pressed, or the dialog or pane you are in, when those have their own help.
The panel slides in beside the page and doesn't block it. While it is open it follows you: move to another page or field and it moves to that help, until you follow a link or search inside the panel.
Escape or the panel's close button closes it and puts you back where you were.

conbody.p: When the server isn't set up to sign you in to the help panel, or you signed in with the admin token, ? opens the same help in a new tab instead.
